title: Gaussian entropy functional
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a real-valued function $f$ on $\bbr^n$, define its Gaussian entropy by $\int f\log f\,d\gamma_n-\bigl(\int f\,d\gamma_n\bigr)\log\bigl(\int f\,d\gamma_n\bigr)$, where $\gamma_n$ is product standard Gaussian measure on $\bbr^n$.
